briefdescription.para: Federated concurrency and replication contract for distributed Process Module deployments.

detaileddescription.para: Defines API contracts for federated consensus, quorum-based voting, crash fault tolerance, and replication consistency guarantees in multi-node Process Module deployments.

sect2.title: Overview
sect2.para: The federation contract specifies thread-safety guarantees, consensus semantics, and replication consistency for Process Module deployments across multiple nodes/shards.

listitem.para: Algorithm: Raft-inspired quorum-based voting (configurable quorum size)
Fault Tolerance: Crash fault tolerant under majority quorum where N >= 2F + 1
Message Ordering: Total ordering via logical clocks on all replicas
Determinism: Consensus outcome deterministic given same failure pattern and messages

sect2.title: Thread-Safety Guarantees

listitem.para: Snapshot Isolation (Model Manager) – Readers do not block writers; writers see consistent snapshots
Fine-Grained Locking (Linker) – Per-link atomicity; independent links do not block each other
Stateless Serializers – Fully thread-safe; no per-instance state
Replicated State Machine – Single writer (leader); multiple readers (followers)

sect2.para: consensus_mutex_→replica_mutex_→log_mutex_→audit_mutex_ All code must respect this ordering; no circular acquisition.

entry.para: Writes complete on leader; async replication

listitem.para: Majority Partition: Continues consensus and accepts writes
Minority Partition: Fails-closed to read-only degraded mode; no writes accepted
Split-Brain Prevention: Quorum-based voting prevents minority from claiming leadership
Automatic Healing: Re-join when partition heals (log sync + catch-up replication)
Network partition → read-only degraded mode (no data loss)
Replica divergence → automatic re-sync from leader
Consensus timeout → return error; application may retry with exponential backoff
Node failure → automatic leader re-election (if quorum available)
Tolerate up to F crash faults where F < N/2 and quorum remains available
Faulty/partitioned nodes cannot commit writes without quorum
Majority must agree on log entries before commit
Quorum Configuration: Minimum 3 nodes (F=1); prefer 5+ for higher availability
Network Assumptions: Intra-DC latency <5ms; inter-DC latencies documented
Storage Backends: RocksDB (primary), S3 (backup), file-based (local dev)
Monitoring: Track consensus latency, replication lag, partition detection time
v2.x single-shard Process Module API unchanged
Federation is opt-in (default: 1 replica = single-shard mode)
Existing applications continue to work without federation awareness
Cross-federation consensus (multi-shard voting across data centers) deferred to Q2 2027
Lock-free data structures for ultra-high-contention scenarios deferred to Q2 2027
ML-based anomaly detection deferred to Q2 2027
